Fletcher, from scratch, gave a fine exhibition of fast walking despite unfavourable conditions and, passing Harley, Latter and Larman in the last quarter of a mile, finished third.

In the 7 miles event promoted by the Cambridge Harriers, our "A" team easily won the scratch team event, while the "B" team annexed the handicap team first prizes. In addition, Harry Larman, a persevering and improving walker, was placed second in the individual handicap.
Jackman gained his first prize and should develop into a class walker, with perseverance, whilst Larman's continued gradual improvement gained for him third position.

Larman managed to beat Jackman for second place, so reversing their positions of the previous Wednesday. Len Fletcher finished fourth from the scratch mark, having covered the two miles in 14min. 25sec. and showed excellent form.
